scope: Private end-to-end click-toggle proof for the current DomainOSApplications QML in Plasma/KWin/Xvfb, using actual PanelButton components and the native Kicker representation.

method.environment: Disposable HOME/XDG, PlasmaWindowed/KWin/Xvfb, private session bus/activity service; no MAME. Existing R610 harness was adapted only in ~/tempia and all new runtime/temp paths were kept there.
method.interaction: QtTest mouse events were sent to the actual QML PanelButton instances. For both the Applications launcher (KDE menu selected) and the pinned-applications drawer launcher, the test opened on click 1, closed on click 2 of the same button, and reopened on click 3.
method.existing_suite: The 71 R610 catalog/favorites/pins assertions were retained and passed. Fourteen additional assertions cover the two launcher open-close-reopen sequences and pointer click delivery.
method.attempts: Runs 1-3 did not test the new assertions because of fixture-path/action/host wiring mistakes. They remain in Tempia; only run4 is used as the result.

limits: Input was generated by QtTest inside the isolated Xvfb/KWin session, not by a physical mouse in the user desktop.
The fixture is not the live lsi panel and does not replace the user’s visual/interaction review.
The test uses synthetic desktop entries and isolated config/data; no production install or user preference was changed.
conclusion: The current DomainOSApplications component and both real PanelButton QML launchers pass same-button open, close and reopen in the private Plasma/KWin fixture; all 85/85 checks pass. This closes the technical test gap for this criterion but does not assert live-session acceptance. P01 remains waiting for the user review.
next: Wait for the user to review the Applications search/focus, category hover, and same-button open/close for both launchers in the live lsi session; keep P01 authorized and do not mark complete before that review.
